description: This file implements server-side logic for the Estimate list page in a SvelteKit application, including data loading, API interactions, and actions for creating, updating, deleting, sending, converting, accepting, and declining estimates.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches and processes estimates, accounts, contacts, and templates data for the Estimate list page, applying search filters, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles the creation of a new estimate by posting form data to the API.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing estimate identified by estimateId with form data.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes an estimate specified by estimateId.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends an estimate via email using the API.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts an estimate into an invoice.
